description: Approved material for Facebook / Instagram / Google posts about TN Appliance Exchange: ready-to-post press release blurbs with links, real 5-star Google reviews (first name + last initial), hashtags, profile links, and the brand rules every post must follow (no part numbers, no customer info, no appointment times, no "best" claims). Use it only when you are writing or scheduling a post about TN Appliance Exchange; it is not for answering a homeowner's repair question. Returns up to 12 reviews plus the matching press releases. Read-only: it posts nothing; the owner approves posts before they go live.

topic.description: Optional filter: keeps press releases and reviews that mention it. Leave empty for everything.

error.description: Present only when the call could not be completed; says what to fix or who to call.

reviews.description: Real public 5-star Google reviews, first name + last initial
